rv.q: If the show still works, it is largely because it boasts one of Lloyd Webber’s best, most tightly composed scores.
For my part, it is the worst production of a musical I have ever seen on a West End stage.

cn.t: Critics split on this Evita revival: while some praise Madalena Alberto's unsentimental performance, technical issues and uneven execution leave the production falling short of its potential.
